item.title: Week 10: Chargers at Ravens
item.description: Mon 11/16 · 8:15 PM ET | Line: BAL -4.5 · O/U 38.5 | Model BAL 88% vs. market 66% | On paper Baltimore has the edge (Baltimore's defense ranks 17th in EPA per dropback with motion, +0.04 allowed). Under center, Justin Herbert ranks 31st of 31 in EPA per dropback; x-factor: Mark Andrews gives back 2.0 yards after the catch vs. expected, and the Chargers' defense ranks 18th in YAC allowed over expected. The model favors Baltimore at 88%, mostly on rushing matchup (5.4 pts) and starting QB (3.4 pts).
